summary: Second security review found that the CI trust checker allows extra jobs and misses wrapped or optioned make ci invocations.
validation: Prior authentication, permission, checkout, and direct command findings were resolved
blockers: CI checker must require exactly the validate job and job-level read-only permissions.
Shell command parser must fail closed on wrappers/options it cannot safely interpret, including env make ci and make -C . ci.
next_action: Harden the checker and add regression tests, then repeat review.
independent_lanes: Exact CI job set and permissions

issues.title: Extra CI jobs escape trust checks
issues.details: Checker validates validate only and permits added self-hosted/write/privileged jobs; require exact job map and job-level permissions.

issues.title: Wrapped or optioned make ci invocation bypasses parser
issues.details: env make ci and make -C . ci are not rejected; fail closed on wrappers/unsupported options or parse them correctly.
